note: A true-size smooth sphere at the catalog’s 22.72 km equatorial-diameter estimate, twice the 11.36 km radius inferred by Choudhury et al. (2024) from NICER pulse-profile modeling and radio timing. It is not a resolved surface photograph. Sphericity and blue-white color are display conventions; hot spots, beams, atmosphere and gravitational lensing are not simulated. The 2024 radius has a 68% interval of -0.63/+0.95 km. A newer NICER analysis (arXiv:2512.08790) finds a broader, larger range, so this is explicitly the catalog’s 2024 estimate, not a unique established radius.
author: Universe Scales
